step1.title: Build the base course for your organization

step2.title: Understand each learner as an individual
step2.description: Before starting, LearnPack asks each learner a small set of questions to understand their background, role, experience level, and learning preferences.

step3.title: Adapt the course to each person
step3.description: LearnPack dynamically adapts examples, explanations, and references so every learner receives the same knowledge, explained in a way that makes sense to them.

q1.question: What is hyperpersonalized learning in LearnPack?
q1.answer: Hyperpersonalized learning in LearnPack is a system that adapts a single training course to each individual learner. It combines organization-specific base content with learner profiling and dynamic adaptation of examples and explanations.

q2.question: How does learner profiling work?
q2.answer: Before starting a course, LearnPack asks each learner around 5 questions about their role, experience, background, and learning preferences. This information is used to personalize the entire learning experience.

q3.question: Is the AI Tutor the same as hyperpersonalization?
q3.answer: No. The AI Tutor is one component that supports the hyperpersonalization system. It provides real-time guidance within the personalized experience but is not the whole system.

q4.question: Does the AI Tutor replace instructors?
q4.answer: No. The AI Tutor supports learners between instructor interactions by clarifying concepts and reducing frustration. Instructors keep control of the learning experience while gaining better visibility into learner progress.
